body.question: May the sole full-suite frozen-input binding error be closed by an explicitly bound targeted recovery plus evidence composition under impact-based validation, or must the entire full suite be rerun through the same process-local frozen-input resolver; and what exact status/identity rules govern the final gate?
body.blocking_constraint: The v3 directive requires final full regression evidence, but the only native full run is correctly FAIL/exit 1. A matching frozen CSV exists, yet rebinding corpus_analytics_baseline.CSV_PATH, even process-locally and without filesystem changes, is a different validation invocation not authorized by post-fusion-directive-3. I will not edit data/code/tests/assertions, skip the test, rerun anything, or relabel the native failure as PASS without a complete updated DIRECTIVE.

evidence.actual: native/child/helper exit 1, signal null, 1657 tests in 1672.755s, FAILED(errors=1), no other reported error/failure/skip; candidate/ref files, listed input manifest and runtime unchanged

evidence.note: The full input manifest SHA e1bbd00cb19ed0b6689c9c2ca24ccb785f018c3611ac165658fa7d86e15f9dcb expressly excludes private resource inputs, so its unchanged flag does not by itself establish this CSV's intended frozen identity.

evidence.binding_source: src/midprojectrag/corpus_analytics_baseline.py defines module global CSV_PATH and EXPECTED_HASHES['refined_csv']; _load_and_bind_inputs resolves that global at call time

evidence.isolated: exit 0; 216 tests/1843.717s/OK; no skips; result SHA256 28b045517d48d6306c3630308ed816ee11bc8587932b573a856f67752cf54f22; native log SHA256 037cbf6b574ccbced8fece3e5b207c738ac8c01d0d4b898e6a2b668cc967e7c8

options.name: targeted recovery plus composed gate
options.procedure: In a fresh recorded process, rebind only midprojectrag.corpus_analytics_baseline.CSV_PATH to the exact archive Path after verifying its expected SHA, then run exactly the one failing TestCase. Preserve the original full FAIL and compose its 1657-test result with the targeted recovery, focused, adjacent and isolated evidence.
options.tradeoff: Smallest impact-based rerun and no product/data mutation, but the final status must be explicitly defined as composed validation rather than a native full-suite PASS.

options.name: resolved-input full rerun
options.procedure: Use the same one-symbol process-local resolver, then execute full unittest discovery in that process and capture a fresh complete result while preserving the original native FAIL.
options.tradeoff: Stronger single-run coverage but repeats roughly 28 minutes and still needs an explicit rule because the launcher is not the literal unwrapped v3 command.

body.recommendation: A, provided the updated directive explicitly authorizes evidence composition and names its final status something such as COMPOSED_VALIDATION_PASS, never native_full_pass. The observed failure is a pre-computation frozen-input binding mismatch outside Owned3/Refs3, while all other collected full tests and all same-candidate scoped/isolated gates have no reported failure. If the integration contract requires one resolved invocation of all full tests with exit 0, choose B instead.
requested_identity_rules: Keep candidate_id and contract_id unchanged and verify Owned3+Refs3/base/branch/runtime before and after; no implementation/report is regenerated from changed product bytes.
Pin and record both the rejected canonical path/hash and the selected archive absolute path/hash/size/mode; require the archive SHA to equal EXPECTED_HASHES['refined_csv'] before test discovery.

Permit only an in-memory assignment to the exact symbol midprojectrag.corpus_analytics_baseline.CSV_PATH for the child process. Prohibit copying, symlinking, editing or restoring the canonical CSV, and prohibit changes to expected hashes, config, gold, test assertions or skip conditions.

Record exact launcher bytes/hash, command, cwd, interpreter/runtime, environment allowlist, start/end candidate/ref/input fingerprints, child exit/signal, native stdout/stderr and test count; use new immutable artifact paths.

Preserve and cite the original exit-1 full result/log as historical failure. Define whether Option A satisfies the required full gate by composition, the exact machine-readable gate label, and whether the fresh deep reviewer must explicitly approve that composition.
Define whether focused/adjacent/isolated evidence remains reusable without rerun and which actor owns the recovery run and evidence-composition record.
body.impact: Implementation remains frozen and REVIEW_READY is withheld. No next-batch, integration, product/contract/config/data/gold/dependency change, profiling, external/model/GCP/private work, or PASS claim proceeds until a complete updated DIRECTIVE resolves the gate.
